author_found_while_responding: Both paper gates failed on the author's own Windows clone for encoding and line-ending reasons alone, and had never been run there. paper-html.py was worse than a failing gate: it silently rewrote 523 line endings in the committed docs/paper/as-on-itch.html. Fixed across the five files of the paper chain (scripts/paper-report.py, scripts/paper-html.py, scripts/paper-figures.sh, python/analysis/intensity_fit.py, python/analysis/gamma_sweep.py); paper-build.sh --check now passes on Windows and every figure regenerates byte-identically, which confirms the reviewer's own check on a second platform.

The report's 17-hour pre-registration gap is 20h57m. The two commits are stamped in different zones (+0000 and -0400) and the report differenced the local wall-clock times. The ordering claim is unaffected and the true gap is larger.
